assignment.title: Should school uniforms be required?
assignment.instructions: Write an opinion about school uniforms. Give two reasons and one example.

goal: Add one example after each reason.

sections.label: Introduction
sections.nextStep: Write one sentence that says why uniforms are good.

sections.label: Body
sections.nextStep: Add one sentence that starts with For example.

tasks.text: Write one sentence that says why uniforms are good.
Add one example about time in the morning.

nextPriorities: Add one example about time in the morning.

sections.label: Introduction
sections.text: I think that school uniforms are good. I think that school uniforms are fair.

sections.label: Body
sections.text: First, uniforms save time in the morning. I think that everyone looks the same. This is good because nobody is judged.

sections.label: Conclusion
sections.text: I think that uniforms are good for our school.

sections.label: Introduction
sections.text: I think that school uniforms are good because they make the school calm.

sections.label: Body
sections.text: First, uniforms save time in the morning because my mother does not have to pick my clothes and we leave the house fast. For example, last week we were not late.

sections.label: Conclusion
sections.text: I think that uniforms are good for our school because they help us learn.

strengths: The opinion now carries a because reason.
improvements: Keep the reason short so the reader follows it easily.
sections.evidence: I think that school uniforms are good because they make the school calm
sections.why: A short reason is easier to check against the task.
sections.nextStep: Cut the second half of the sentence or start a new sentence.

strengths: The For example sentence is exactly what the task asked for.
improvements: Split the long first sentence after the word clothes.
sections.evidence: For example, last week we were not late
sections.why: A reader needs one idea at a time.
sections.nextStep: Put a full stop after clothes and start the next word with We.

strengths: You linked the opinion to learning in the last sentence.
improvements: Say which lesson learning helps most.
sections.why: One clear detail makes the closing stronger.
sections.nextStep: Name one lesson where you learn better in uniform.

overall.summary: You added the example the task asked for and linked your opinion to reasons. Next, split the long sentence in the middle.
nextPriorities: Split the long middle sentence after clothes.
